title: 4 Common Types of Cosmetic Surgery in Baton Rouge
metaDescription: Cosmetic surgery can help you tighten and improve the overall appearance of your skin, add or do away with unwanted hair, adjust your facial features...
html:
When an individual is interested in changing their appearance to reach their ideal look, they often tend to turn to Hanemann Plastic Surgery in Baton Rouge. Cosmetic surgery can help you tighten and improve the overall appearance of your skin, add or do away with unwanted hair, adjust your facial features and achieve much more. It is important to note that cosmetic surgery may also be used for medical drives; for instance, by people who may have been in an accident.

People can use plastic surgery to repair scars and to restore the functions of certain body parts. Currently, there are many cosmetic procedures that are available.

Breast Augmentation

Breast augmentation is a term used to refer to the procedure that can assist in increasing the size, and in some cases change the shape of a woman’s breast. When a woman chooses to increase the size of her breasts, this procedure is referred to as breast implant surgery. You should note that breast augmentation is not the same as breast reduction or breast lifts. These are very different kinds of procedures.

Dermabrasion

Dermabrasion is a type of cosmetic surgery in Baton Rouge that makes use of specialized tools to gently sand down the uppermost skin layers. When this uppermost layer of the skin is eliminated, the region will begin to heal, with new skin replacing the one that has been removed.

Normally, the procedure is used for:

  • Wrinkles
  • Acne spots
  • Sun-damaged skin
  • Age spots
  • Lesions or growths that are present on the skin surface
  • Crow’s feet

Facelift

A facelift is a kind of cosmetic surgery that is used to repair wrinkled or loose skin that may be present on your face. In the course of this procedure, excess skin will be removed, facial tissues lifted and the skin will then be replaced over contours that have been repositioned. Traditionally, neck lifts have been known to be done together with the facelifts.

Lip Augmentation

This is a procedure whose main aim is to provide a patient with a full-looking lip. In many cases, injectable dermal fillers will be used in increasing the volume of the lip, structure or shape. The procedure is not permanent, though its effects tend to last for a period of six months.

If you are looking to get cosmetic surgery in Baton Rouge, be sure to get in touch with Hanemann Plastic Surgery. You can also visit our offices or contact us for detailed information on available cosmetic procedures.
